name: Monk Amsterdam
description: Monk Amsterdam is a bouldering gym on the IJ waterfront in Amsterdam Noord. Its climbing walls occupy part of a large industrial factory compound; the black corrugated facade, tall workshop doors and upper glazing retain the building’s working character. The gym combines climbing with a waterside café and terrace.
